notes: All 192 upstream archive members are preserved byte-for-byte. Caller enables only the original with-serde feature with default features disabled; persistence remains disabled.

The first private SDK/empty-target build reached DBSP and exposed a missing caller feature. The original source and 184 dependency versions/checksums are unchanged; an explicit feature/lock-edge fix was followed by successful local-cache compilation. Both attempts are retained, without an uninterrupted-cold-build claim.

Only the fixed historical local Rust core and non-NULL integer bag operations are qualified; Feldera SQL frontend, platform services, connectors, persistence, accounts and distributed execution were not used.
Runtime requires Linux x86_64, Python sqlite3 and compatible host libgcc_s/libm/libc/ELF loader; observed host glibc 2.39. No cross-host binary identity is claimed.

A new source rebuild uses the three immutable Rust 1.75.0 archives in common support plus host C compiler/linker and Python 3.12; SDK, source/vendor, Cargo home and target are private to the selected build directory.
184 component source and license records are supplied; 133 were actually compiled on this host and 51 are retained conditional/non-host dependencies.
